title: USF Observability Signal Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for observability signal definitions (logs, metrics, traces, spans, runtime events, runtime proof outputs, service/resource attributes, correlation identifiers). Each declares its kind (observability-signal-kinds), name, source, and purpose, mapped to a semantic contract and to proof/evidence where applicable. Observability is a semantic asset: removing or renaming a signal requires semantic review, not an incidental refactor. USF claims no full OpenTelemetry compliance until concrete attribute schemas exist. Governs the ontology concept Observability Signal. lifecycleState draft; not active. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11). Envelope fields kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated and intentionally not required: this artefact is not a top-level artefact-kind and instance versioning is deferred to instance-topology definition (recorded deviation per schema-authoring-standard section 9.3).

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels canonical value pinned to this schema's registry authorityRole.
